_doc: Mission file (openspec/changes/mission-scripting; the format is docs/design/mission-files.md). Edit with tools/mission-editor or by hand.
name: Deliver the prize
objective: Bring the {prize_name} in to the research yard at {home}, and keep the {name(fac)} from taking her back.
brief: The {prize_name} is under tow to the research yard at {home}. The {name(fac)} know where she is going: expect them to try to take her back on the last leg. The bounty is paid on delivery.

result.log: Research has the {prize_name}: the {name(fac)} {cls}'s drive and shields are being taken apart.
The {name(fac)} took the {prize_name} back before she reached {home}.

objectives.text: Keep the {prize_name} above half her hull
